title: Mario's regression: "Because he's here"

tellings.quote: And the little one, the small one, just as plain as day, says, "Because he's here."

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that under regression, a kind of hypnosis meant to bring back buried memories, he recalled being aboard a craft in 1977, where a small being said "just as plain as day", "Because he's here." He tells Michels this as his own memory, and links the moment to another Air Force veteran, Michael Johnson, who the episode says was taken with him.
